_meta.note: All 13 canonical locations for Sunny and the Crew. Always use the canonical prompt anchor and existing Higgsfield job IDs — do not improvise new settings. InVideo element references listed per location.

locations.name: Sunny's Bedroom
locations.description: Sunny's cozy bedroom with warm yellow walls, a sunflower-patterned bedspread, a bookshelf full of colorful books, fairy lights strung above the bed, a small desk near the window with afternoon light streaming in. A cork board above the desk with drawings and photos pinned to it. Plush cloud rug on the floor. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: yellow bedroom, sunflower bedspread, fairy lights, bookshelf, cork board, plush cloud rug, warm afternoon window light

locations.name: Corner Store / Bodega
locations.description: A bright neighborhood corner store with a colorful awning (yellow and green stripes), an open produce stand out front with fruits and vegetables, a hand-painted sign, a screen door that jingles, and a warm amber interior with wooden shelves. Friendly neighborhood vibe. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: yellow green striped awning, produce stand, screen door, wooden shelves, warm amber interior, neighborhood corner store

locations.name: The Coop — Exterior
locations.description: A converted two-story brick building painted bright yellow with a cheerful green roof. A hand-painted sign reads 'THE COOP' in bold colorful letters. A wide front stoop with potted plants and a welcome mat. Children's murals painted on the side wall. Sunny neighborhood block backdrop. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: bright yellow brick building, green roof, THE COOP sign, front stoop, children's murals, neighborhood block

locations.name: The Coop — Classroom
locations.description: Bright, cheerful classroom inside The Coop. Small round tables with chairs, alphabet posters and children's artwork on the walls, a large window with sunshine pouring in, a reading corner with a cozy rug and cushions, a whiteboard at the front. Warm and inviting learning space. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: round tables, alphabet wall posters, children's artwork, reading corner rug and cushions, whiteboard, large sunny window

locations.name: The Coop — Music Room
locations.description: A vibrant music room with colorful instruments on the walls (tambourines, maracas, ukuleles), a small stage area at one end, music note bunting hanging from the ceiling, a piano in the corner, and a large open floor space for dancing. Warm bright lighting. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: instruments on walls, tambourines maracas ukuleles, small stage, music note bunting, piano corner, open dance floor

locations.name: The Coop — Outdoor Playground
locations.description: A cheerful outdoor play area behind The Coop. Colorful painted hopscotch on the ground, a small climbing structure, a sandbox, raised garden beds with vegetables and flowers, picnic tables under a shade tree. Enclosed by a bright painted fence. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: hopscotch painted ground, climbing structure, sandbox, raised garden beds, picnic tables, shade tree, painted fence

locations.name: Mayor Mary's Office
locations.description: A welcoming, slightly over-decorated office with a large wooden desk covered in papers, a big window overlooking the neighborhood, framed photos of community events on the walls, a bookshelf full of binders and trophies, a small couch with a local map above it, and fresh flowers on the windowsill. Warm natural light. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: large wooden desk, neighborhood window view, framed community photos, bookshelf trophies, local map, fresh flowers on windowsill
locations.energy: official but friendly, community-serving, slightly comedic

locations.name: Sunny Side Street
locations.description: A quiet, tree-lined side street off the main neighborhood. Dappled light through oak trees, a fire hydrant painted red and yellow, chalk drawings on the sidewalk, a neighbor's garden with a white picket fence. Peaceful neighborhood energy. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: tree-lined side street, dappled oak tree light, chalk sidewalk drawings, red yellow fire hydrant, garden with white picket fence

locations.name: Nana Blossom's Porch
locations.description: A wide, shaded front porch with a porch swing, potted plants of every kind, wind chimes hanging from the eave, a woven rug, a small wooden table with a tea tray, and Nana's garden visible past the porch railing. Warm golden afternoon light. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: wide shaded porch, porch swing, potted plants, wind chimes, woven rug, tea tray table, lush garden visible, golden afternoon light

locations.name: Sunny's Front Porch
locations.description: Warm wooden front porch with a yellow front door, potted sunflowers in terracotta pots, a welcome mat that says WELCOME in bright letters, porch steps leading down to a green lawn. Cozy neighborhood backdrop with neighbor houses visible on either side. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: yellow front door, sunflowers in terracotta pots, WELCOME mat, porch steps, green lawn, neighbor houses backdrop

locations.name: Sunny's Backyard
locations.description: Bright backyard with a wooden fence painted white, green grass, a small garden patch with sunflowers and tomatoes, a red picnic table with benches, and a clothesline strung with colorful fabric. Morning or warm afternoon light. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: white wooden fence, green grass, sunflower and tomato garden patch, red picnic table, colorful clothesline, warm afternoon light

locations.name: Sunny's Neighborhood Street
locations.description: Wide, sunny neighborhood street with clean sidewalks, well-kept green lawns, colorful houses in yellow, blue, green, and coral. Mailboxes at each house. Blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Warm afternoon light. Tree-lined with oak and maple. Friendly neighborhood energy. 3D cartoon-style render.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: wide sunny street, colorful houses, clean sidewalk, mailboxes, oak and maple trees, blue sky fluffy clouds, warm afternoon light

locations.name: Camera Direct Address
locations.description: Character faces directly into the camera against a simple warm background. Solid warm yellow gradient or soft sky-blue gradient. Clean, minimal, no location detail. Used exclusively for talking-to-audience moments, participatory beats, call-and-response beats, and outro sequences.
locations.canonical_prompt_anchor: facing directly into camera, simple warm yellow gradient background, clean minimal, direct address to audience
locations.energy: intimate, engaging, participatory, breaking fourth wall

location_rules: Always use the canonical_prompt_anchor as the base for any Higgsfield or InVideo location prompt — do not improvise new settings
If a location has existing Higgsfield job IDs, reference those images first before generating new assets
New location asset generations must be added to higgsfield_job_ids immediately after generation
InVideo element references use the @Element format exactly as listed — no substitutions
LOC_DIRECT_ADDRESS is not a physical location — it is a cinematographic convention for participatory beats only
The Coop and Sunny's neighborhood are the primary recurring locations across all episodes
